# Chiplet_Integration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-24

## Definition
Chiplet integration is the assembly of multiple smaller dies into a single package through high-speed die-to-die interconnects. It directly determines the physical topology and communication fabric in TCC systems, affecting latency, bandwidth, and scalability.
